Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: computational geometry | ID: 21501

Step 2. Using the nilpotent regularization, we obtain \(S_{01330012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Lebesgue space.

Step 3. By the continuous spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the continuous spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via spectral interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
